title: Paros, Antiparos and Naxos by Ferry

bestPeriod.window: Late May to June and September to mid-October
bestPeriod.note: The sea is warmest in September.
bestPeriod.avoid: July and August, when the meltemi wind and prices both peak
bestPeriod.raw: May to June, September to October

transport.note: Three ferries on deck, island buses

activities.note: Antiparos cave, Portara at sunset, a boat trip

gatewayAirport: ATH Athens, 1 h to Piraeus by metro; home by ferry or from JNX Naxos
summary: Three Cycladic islands and no car. Paros for fishing harbours and white lanes, tiny Antiparos ten minutes across the strait for its cave and empty beaches, and Naxos, the biggest and greenest, for the marble Portara at sunset and long sandy beaches. Every hop is a short ferry and every island has a bus.
hook: Three islands, three short ferries and the Portara of Naxos at sunset.

itinerary.title: Athens and the Acropolis
itinerary.morning: Metro from the airport to the centre, 40 minutes. Afternoon at the Acropolis, about €20.
itinerary.afternoon: Plaka and Anafiotika's island lanes under the rock.
itinerary.evening: Sunset from the Areopagus hill, free, then souvlaki.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Paros
itinerary.morning: Morning ferry from Piraeus to Paros, 3 to 4 hours on a conventional boat, from €40 on deck.
itinerary.afternoon: Settle in Parikia and visit the Panagia Ekatontapyliani, the church of a hundred doors.
itinerary.evening: Sunset on the windmill quay, drinks by the old harbour.

itinerary.title: Naoussa and Kolymbithres
itinerary.morning: Bus to Naoussa, the fishing harbour with tavernas on the quay.
itinerary.afternoon: Swim among the wind-carved granite of Kolymbithres beach.
itinerary.evening: Grilled octopus by the boats in Naoussa.

itinerary.title: Antiparos
itinerary.morning: Bus to Pounta, then the 10 minute ferry to Antiparos, about €2.
itinerary.afternoon: The Cave of Antiparos, 400 steps down into stalactites, about €6; then a quiet beach.
itinerary.evening: Dinner on Antiparos' main street before the last boat.

itinerary.title: Hop to Naxos
itinerary.morning: Ferry from Parikia to Naxos in about 45 minutes, from €10.
itinerary.afternoon: Old town lanes up to the Venetian castle.
itinerary.evening: The marble Portara at sunset, the gate of an unfinished temple of Apollo.

itinerary.title: Naxos beaches or the mountain villages
itinerary.morning: Bus to Agios Prokopios and its long sandy beach.
itinerary.afternoon: Or the bus inland to Halki and Apiranthos, marble villages and kitron liqueur.
itinerary.evening: Taverna dinner in the old town.

itinerary.title: Back to Athens
itinerary.morning: Ferry from Naxos to Piraeus, about 5 hours, or a 40 minute flight from Naxos airport.

accommodationStrategy.name: Studio in Parikia
accommodationStrategy.description: Family-run studios with a kitchenette, five minutes from the port.
accommodationStrategy.booking: a month ahead in June and September
accommodationStrategy.priceNote: €45 to €80 a night for the studio

accommodationStrategy.name: Room in Naxos town
accommodationStrategy.description: Rooms in the old town or at Agios Georgios beach.

logistics.connectivity: EU roaming; 4G on all three islands.
logistics.weather: The meltemi blows hardest in July and August and can cancel small boats.
logistics.bookingWindows: Book Piraeus ferries two to three weeks ahead; island hops can be bought the day before.
logistics.money: Euro; cards widely taken, small tavernas prefer cash.
logistics.transportRules: Deck class is the cheapest ticket and has seats inside and out.
logistics.health: Strong sun from May; shade is rare on the beaches.
logistics.gettingThere: Fly to Athens and take the metro to Piraeus.

proTips: Compare conventional and fast ferries: the slow boat is half the price and steadier in wind.
Stay in Parikia on Paros: every ferry and bus leaves from there.

raw.Who It Suits: Couples, friends and families who want beaches without a car

typeSpecific.windConditions: Meltemi north wind in July and August
typeSpecific.bookingTimeline: Ferries 2 to 3 weeks ahead from Piraeus

packingNotes: A light jacket for the ferry deck
whatCouldGoWrong: A meltemi day can cancel the small Antiparos boats; move the cave day.
Ferries run late in summer; never book a flight on the same afternoon.

highlights.title: The Portara at sunset

highlights.title: Naoussa harbour
highlights.line: Fishing boats, octopus drying in the sun and tavernas on the quay.

highlights.title: Cave of Antiparos
highlights.line: 400 steps down into a hall of stalactites.

highlights.title: The Acropolis
highlights.line: Start the week on the rock above Athens.
